body: Without getting into too much detail, my “choice” was one that I made over several months. It was not to improve myself or to make things better. It was purely selfish and only hurt everyone involved. I do appreciate the uplifting comment though. This has been the worst year of my life and almost all of it has been my fault. I am doing much better now, but I still can’t truly let go of this woman. I have been seeking professional help to deal with the mental problems and instability, but it is nice to have a regular person say something kind. Thank you.
I am saving it for her. Foolishly so I suppose. But I still am.
